مُجْذَوْذٍ [in the CK, erroneously, المَجْذُوْذِىُّ,] Keeping constantly to the dwelling, or to the camel's saddle and the dwelling, (الرَّحْل and المَنْزِل, AA, S, K,) not quitting it: (AA, S:) like مُجْذَوْذٍ عَلَى الرَّحْلِ. (AA, S) ―
-b2- And A man who lowers, or abases, himself; (El-Hejeree, ISd, TA;) as though he clave to the ground by reason of his abjectness; from جَذَا القُرَادُ فِى جَنْبِ البَعِيرِ [q. v.]. (ISd, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
